hero.summary: The proposed decarbonization plan funds green power switch at 40%, rooftop solar pv at 60%, fleet electrification at 50%, committing $8.7M of the $10.0M three-year budget and leaving $1.3M unallocated. Modeled against the 12,000 tCO2e Scope 1+2 baseline, this sequence reaches a 41.0% reduction by 2030 — clearing the board's 40%-by-2030 commitment with headroom. That leaves a residual footprint of 7,080 tCO2e in 2030, concentrated in Scope 1 process heat and the un-electrified balance of the fleet. The single highest-leverage next move is to extend green power switch — the cheapest abatement per tonne in this portfolio — using the remaining $1.3M before adding new capital.
